stem.text: A student connects two loudspeakers to a signal generator.

stem.alt: Signal generator connected to two loudspeakers. A person is seen from above with an arrow pointing upward towards a point labelled Q; a point labelled P is below.

stem.text: As the student walks from P to Q, he notices that the loudness of the sound rises and falls repeatedly.
What causes the loudness of the sound to vary?

B.text: Doppler shift of the sound waves
